items.q: What kind of issues can be reported?
items.a: Public road and facility issues such as roads, bridges, streetlights, drainage, sidewalks, bus shelters, parks, and other civic assets.

items.q: How do I submit a report?
items.a: Open the report page, write a brief description, upload photos, and pin the damaged location on the map.
Municipal officers review each submission for authenticity before dispatching maintenance teams.

items.q: How can I monitor the repair progress?
items.a: You can follow milestone updates from initial verification through repair completion.

items.q: What is the benefit of the navigation feature?
items.a: The map displays verified road hazards and calculates detour routes so you can drive safely.
